title: Evaluating the impact of prompting styles on LLM accuracy for AIME math questions

live_model.evidence: 'ChatGPT Free (GPT-3.5), ChatGPT Plus (GPT-4-turbo)...accessed through their respective websites...via chat.openai.com'

prompt.location: Materials and Methods (prompting-style templates described per condition; each problem presented separately per style in its own chat session)

claim.metric: accuracy (number of AIME problems solved correctly)
claim.location: 60 problems total (4 AIME exams: 2024 I/II, 2025 I/II), repeated across 3 independent chat sessions per model/style

notes: Otherwise a clean setup (public AIME problems, n=60, clear methodology, stable across repeated sessions), but the model was accessed through the ChatGPT Plus website rather than the API, and 'GPT-4-turbo' is the authors' own label for whatever ChatGPT Plus served on the test date rather than a confirmed pinned snapshot.
